fact_rationales.F19: The presence of oligoclonal bands in the CSF is a hallmark of Multiple Sclerosis (B4.1) and can also be seen in other inflammatory conditions like Autoimmune Encephalitis (B4.3) and Neurosarcoidosis (B4.9).
fact_rationales.F25: Extensive white matter changes are more typical of demyelinating diseases like Multiple Sclerosis (B4.1) and less typical of vascular disorders like Stroke (B4.2) or CNS Vasculitis (B4.4).
fact_rationales.F31: The presence of lymphocytes, plasma cells, and multinucleated giant cells in the brain biopsy suggests an inflammatory process, which could be seen in conditions like Autoimmune Encephalitis (B4.3) or Neurosarcoidosis (B4.9), but is less typical of vascular disorders.
